methodology.rank: 1-based within gender among actual calculateAthleteRanking rows, using sortAthletesByRanking tie-breaks; unranked catalog tail excluded
methodology.score: Unrounded production score; null if absent from calculateAthleteRanking
methodology.resultRows: All runtime result rows linked by athleteId, including DNS/DNF/DSQ and rows not eligible for current ranking
methodology.priority: A: gender rank <=100 OR resultRows>=5; otherwise B: gender rank 101–300 OR resultRows 3–4; otherwise C
methodology.reportOrder: Ascending gender rank; MEN before WOMEN at equal rank; unranked last
methodology.reviewReasons: Copied verbatim from the corresponding wave fixture
